title: Operational Planner (I) (LtCol to Maj) FMOS, DC PP&O
raw_text:
2.     MOS 0505, Operational Planner (I) (LtCol to Maj) FMOS, DC PP&O

    a. Summary. Marine Air Ground Task Force (MAGTF) Planners complete an
advanced education program (service or joint) that prepares them to lead
operational planning teams and conduct actions surrounding complex issues.
MAGTF planner billets will be allocated to CMC-specified priorities on
selected Marine Corps staffs in planning and operational billets. Designated
billets will be allocated via proportional share with emphasis on marine
expeditionary forces (MEFs) and major subordinate commands (MSCs), then to
marine component headquarters and the staffs of deputy commandants. As a
non-PMOS MOS only, MAGTF Planners will be used to fill appropriate joint and


                                          1-30                           Enclosure (1)
 1108                                                               NAVMC 1200.1L



marine corps billets requiring planning expertise and complex problem-solving
skills during tours later in their careers at the discretion of their primary
MOS monitor.

    b. Prerequisites. ILS complete (resident or non-resident) or, in the
case of MAWS, currently enrolled. MAGTF Planners require top secret/
sensitive.

    c. Requirements. Complete one of the following schools: Marine Corps
School of Advanced Warfighting, Quantico, VA; U.S. Army School of Advanced
Military Studies, Ft Leavenworth, KS, U.S. Air Force, School of Advanced Air
and Space Studies, Maxwell AFB, AL, Maritime Advanced Warfighting School,
Newport, RI, Navy War College Advanced Strategist Program, Newport, RI, or
Joint Advanced Warfare School, Norfolk, VA.

    d. Duties. Lead planning efforts for major commands. Conduct complex
problem solving, create and employ operational art, and design and execute
campaigns.

    e. Related Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) Title and Code.
Command and Control Center Officers 55-1015.

       f.   Related Military Skill.   None.

nlx_method: NLx employer-demand profiles; private-only ownership unverified. Six-digit profiles pool specialty weighted task incidences after the existing review exclusion mask and five-job task-support floor; destination SOCs require 200 postings and nonzero tasks. Military profiles use binary accepted task presence and the same NLx reference RCA weights as civilian profiles: reciprocal positive task shares (zero weight for reference-absent tasks) of pooled retained support-five NLx weighted incidences across 1,016 reference specialties (912 eligible comparison candidates), sqrt(q * rca_weight), then L2 normalization and cosine. No military crosswalk codes enter the task ranking. All positive top-20 results retained; zero-similarity destinations are not recommendations. Shared field/rating duties are included; general Naval Standards remain separate by paygrade. Summary compares non-future individual source entries (versions can repeat) with nonempty reference sets; grouped, future and general-standard entries remain in all outputs. Hit@k is the fraction with at least one reference SOC recovered; ties are averaged exactly. References outside NLx remain in denominators. DMDC reference status is from July 2024, not current 2026 status.
